task.title: P6-174: Fix three test-strength leftovers from tree-move and header-kebab
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-174. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**Three test-strength leftovers from the tree-move and header-kebab rounds** (was `P6-024e` + `P6-017g` + `P6-017h`): the `ContextMenu`/`Shift+F10` route on `RowShell` (`tree.rs:426-444`) has **no test at any tier** — the bench check exercises `ContextMenuTrigger`'s handler, a different code path — and `Shift+F10` has no macOS equivalent, leaving `⋯` as the only keyboard opener there; `bench/header_kebab.rs:57-84` renders a hand-copied stand-in menu instead of `TreeMenu`, so it **looks like** it catches drift between the two real panels' item sets and cannot; and `collection-header-kebab.spec.ts:430`'s `page.locator("h1", { hasText: "All cards" }).first()` drops the single-visible-heading strictness the mobile-`/my` task established.
